member.name: T:Yokko.Desktop.Diagnostics.CrashReportHandler
member.summary: Captures fatal managed exceptions and writes a self-contained diagnostic report without interfering with the original crash.

member.name: M:Yokko.Desktop.Diagnostics.CrashReportHandler.SetStoragePaths(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Moves future reports into the host's user storage once it is available.

member.name: M:Yokko.Desktop.Diagnostics.CrashReportHandler.TryWrite(System.Exception,System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Tries to synchronously persist a fatal exception. No reporting failure is allowed to replace or hide the original exception.
